mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supplier_documents (id, tenant_id, application_id, uploaded_by, object_key, original_filename, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, scan_status, created_at) VALUES (#{id, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{tenantId}, #{applicationId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{uploadedBy, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{objectKey}, #{originalFilename}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{sha256}, #{scanStatus}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, application_id, uploaded_by, object_key, original_filename, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, scan_status, created_at FROM supplier_documents WHERE application_id = #{applicationId, jdbcType=OTHER} ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT id, tenant_id, application_id, uploaded_by, object_key, original_filename, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, scan_status, created_at FROM supplier_documents WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=OTHER}
